definitions.explanation: a breath; a rest; a breather
in one breath; all at once; without stopping

examples.japanese: ちょっと{一息|ひといき}つこう。
{仕事|しごと}の{合間|あいま}に{一息|ひといき}{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To take a break between work.

examples.japanese: コーヒーを{飲|の}んで{一息|ひといき}ついた。
examples.english: I had some coffee and took a breather.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はビールを{一息|ひといき}に{飲|の}み{干|ほ}した。
examples.english: He drank the beer in one gulp.

examples.japanese: {階段|かいだん}を{一息|ひといき}に{駆|か}け{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I ran up the stairs without stopping.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}を{一息|ひといき}に{書|か}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I wrote the letter in one sitting.

notes:
{一息|ひといき} literally means "one breath" and has two main uses.

Sense 1 (a rest/breather):
- {一息|ひといき}つく (to take a breather)
- {一息|ひといき}{入|い}れる (to take a break)

Sense 2 (in one breath/without stopping):
- {一息|ひといき}に (adverbial: in one go, without pause)
- {一息|ひといき}で (same meaning)

Related expressions:
- ひと{休|やす}み (a short rest)
- {息抜|いきぬ}き (taking a break, relaxation)
